entries.title: Manash Bagchi - Presentation - Technology for Museums - VMPME Workshop - Science City - Kolkata 2015-07-16 9125.JPG
entries.description: This photograph has been taken during the 2nd day of the 'Workshop on Museums in Digital Era' of the 'Vivekananda Memorial Programme for Museum Excellence' that was organised by the Ministry of culture, Govt. of India in collaboration with the 'Art Institute of Chicago' (AIC) and the 'National Council of Science Museums', India. The four days duration workshop was held at the 'Science City', Kolkata, about 40 museum professionals participated at the event.
entries.creator: Biswarup Ganguly
